results.name: a current range wider than the old compliance survives the new one
results.detail: SAFETY: the instrument is not in the state it was asked for. asked for 0.001 A, instrument reports 0.000105 A. A range that carries 0.001 A on this model reports between 0.001 and 0.0011 A. Narrower than that clamps a source level and overranges a reading into a sentinel; wider means resolution was given away without anyone choosing to - asked for 0.001 A while the compliance was 0.0001 A, then raised the compliance to 0.001 A. An instrument that refuses a range wider than its compliance has to be sent the range again once the limit arrives
